name: István Kovács
bio:
István's fascination with motorsport began in his childhood, tinkering with his father's old Lada in their Budapest garage. This passion led him to pursue a degree in electrical engineering, after which he immediately sought a role in motorsport. His career started with a small touring car team, where he quickly proved his aptitude for diagnosing and resolving complex electronic issues. He spent over a decade honing his skills in various racing series, from GT racing to Formula 3, before deciding to offer his services as a free agent.

Known for his meticulous approach and calm demeanor under pressure, István is highly regarded for his ability to extract maximum performance from the electronic systems of a race car. He's particularly adept at data analysis and identifying subtle improvements that can shave crucial tenths of a second off lap times. His work ethic and ability to quickly learn new technologies makes him a valuable asset to any racing team.

István is distinguished by his relentless pursuit of perfection and his ability to simplify complex problems. He believes that clear communication and a collaborative approach are essential for success in the high-pressure environment of motorsport. He is always eager to share his knowledge with younger engineers, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: István is of average height with a slightly stocky build.
